remarks: Welcome to 60 Strawberry Hill Avenue, where convenience meets comfort in the heart of vibrant Downtown Stamford. This spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence offers an open-concept layout flooded with natural light, perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. The primary suite features a full bath, while generous closet space and large windows enhance both bedrooms. Enjoy worry-free living with all utilities-heat, A/C, hot water, and electricity-fully included in the HOA. The building offers a full suite of amenities, including a doorman, fitness center, covered parking, and on-site laundry. Whether you're commuting or exploring, you're just minutes from top restaurants, shopping, Metro-North, and major highways. Don't miss this opportunity to own a bright, move-in-ready unit in one of Stamford's most desirable locations.
